profile.summary: WikiDiscoverer is a JavaScript developer with contributions primarily focused on the Moment.js library, specializing in locale additions and corrections. Their experience is centered around JavaScript utility libraries rather than frameworks, with demonstrated proficiency in ES6+ features, modular JavaScript code structure, and unit testing. While they have contributed to a widely-used JavaScript library, their contributions are limited to internal library mechanics (specifically locale handling) rather than broader frontend/backend systems or modern tooling. This suggests a junior-level expertise with strong foundational knowledge of JavaScript but minimal exposure to full-stack development or advanced JavaScript ecosystems.
